item.title: [ 16 Maps ] Blood Medal (Early Access)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
[Project Background] This asset comes from an abandoned campaign concept inspired by Call of Duty: Modern Warfare & Back 4 Blood, which I spent about 6 months developing. The project remained in an early beta stage and was never finished. It featured ported assets from CoD 4 & B4B (maps, models, etc.), along with a custom VScript setup where military NPCs used assault logic to replace Special Infected—moving, taking positions, and shooting directly at players. The Abomination was planned as the final boss fight, complete with custom mapping, scripts, and cutscenes. I abandoned the project, and I currently have no plans to complete or release the full campaign. Major polish was still missing (bot NAV mesh navigation, cutscene animations, custom events, and overall tuning). I just wanted to share this abandoned idea with you. I'm not promising anything, but perhaps I'll pick up this project again in the future, but for now, it remains unfinished. I have also withdrawn the public version, limiting it to early access only.

item.title: [ Map ] Parasite Station 2 Sv. (Halo Reach Vers.)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
This is a L4D1 port of a survival map by X3Ent3nte FOXHOUND. I love this guys textures and have ported some of his other work in the past. I've been playing with making skyboxes so I borrowed this one from Zombies from Planet X1 by RYOK. His map was so bright it was hard to appreciate it. Here you can see his kewl skymap in all it's glory. All the other campaigns I ported of X3Ent3nte will have new skyboxes that I've created. I call this the Halo Reach version because it has some Halo Reach Models in it. Have fun :) - What you see is a modified transport ship attacking the facility and two missiles and a pelican reaching out to stop the baddie. I found those Halo Models out on the internet. If they belong to anyone I think they are pretty awesome.
